verdict.rationale: Evidence shows self-hosting, open-source code, and DB access via Drizzle Studio for developers, but nothing documents a user-facing data export feature in open formats (e.g., mbox/eml export or account portability tool). Missing for 10: an explicit export-all-data feature, documentation of open/interoperable export formats, and evidence of a straightforward 'leave with your data' workflow for end users.
